name: Facets Navigation Links Widget
description: Provides a Facets widget that renders facet results as a list of navigation links.
project_description: Provides a Facets widget that displays a facet's results as a list of navigation links wrapped in a <nav> element. Facets core already ships a "List of links" widget, but those links behave like toggle buttons — clicking the active link resets it — which makes them awkward to use as ordinary page navigation and creates accessibility problems for screen readers. This module's "List of navigation links" widget renders the active facet as a real, followable link and offers an optional reset ("Show all") link, giving facet-driven navigation that behaves and reads like normal links.
